transcript.prompt: Draw 1 of 60: a red ball appears. You have 3 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
With no frequency information yet and only 3 slots for 8 colors, preserving flexibility is more valuable than locking in the first color.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: Draw 2 of 60: a blue ball appears. You have 3 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Blue has appeared only once, so there is still no evidence it is among the three most common colors; keep all slots flexible.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: Draw 3 of 60: a blue ball appears. You have 3 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Blue is the first color to repeat and currently has the strongest evidence of being common. With 58 draws remaining including this one, locking it in now has substantial upside.

DECISION: KEEP

transcript.prompt: Draw 4 of 60: a green ball appears. You have 2 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Green has appeared only once, while just two slots remain; wait for stronger evidence before committing another slot.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: Draw 5 of 60: a yellow ball appears. You have 2 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Yellow is only a first appearance, and with two slots left there is little evidence it will be among the best remaining colors.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: Draw 6 of 60: a yellow ball appears. You have 2 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Yellow has now repeated quickly, matching blue’s early signal, and there are still 55 draws including this one to collect its future occurrences.

DECISION: KEEP

transcript.prompt: Draw 7 of 60: a green ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Green has now appeared twice, but with only one slot left and most of the game remaining, it is better to wait for clearer evidence among the six unkept colors.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: Draw 8 of 60: a purple ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Purple is only on its first appearance, so it does not justify using the final slot while green has repeated and many draws remain.

DECISION: PASS

transcript.prompt: (Since your last choice: draw 9: another yellow ball (already kept -> auto-collected, +1); draw 10: another yellow ball (already kept -> auto-collected, +1).) Draw 11 of 60: a green ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
Green has now appeared three times and leads all unkept colors, providing enough evidence of a high rate to use the final slot with 50 draws remaining.

DECISION: KEEP
